local_facts.title: A late-1980s housing baseline
local_facts.claim: The 2020–2024 American Community Survey estimate puts Carrollton’s median year structure built at 1988.
local_facts.why_it_matters: Late-1980s and 1990s garages often retain original-era torsion hardware, rollers, tracks or operators, so measurements and a full system inspection matter before parts are selected.

local_facts.title: Same-size door rule
local_facts.claim: Carrollton says replacing doors or windows with those of the same size does not require a permit; changing the opening size does require one.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A spring repair or like-for-like door swap is different from widening, moving or reframing a garage opening, which should be confirmed with the City before work begins.

local_facts.title: May 2024 straight-line wind damage
local_facts.claim: Carrollton reports that the May 28, 2024 storm brought straight-line winds of 80 to 95 mph and affected all 37.1 square miles of the city.
local_facts.why_it_matters: After a major storm, a garage-door inspection should look past cosmetic dents to tracks, hinges, struts and rollers that may have been pushed out of alignment.
